pawReactorSystems.name: Commercial Continuous Venturi Hydrodynamic Cavitation PAW Skid (AISI 316L / 3-A Sanitary)
pawReactorSystems.classification: Industrial In-Line Plasma-Liquid Flow Reactor (EHEDG Class I / CE Pressure Equipment Directive)
pawReactorSystems.gasInjectionType: Filtered Dry Atmospheric Air + O2 Enrichment (Dew Point < -40°C)
pawReactorSystems.reactorCoreMaterial: High-Purity Fused Quartz Dielectric Barrier Tubes with Water-Cooled Ground Electrodes
pawReactorSystems.venturiNozzleGeometry: Dual-Throat Supersonic Cavitation Ejector (Throat Diameter 4.2 mm, Area Ratio 4:1)
pawReactorSystems.catalyticOzoneDestructor: Granular Manganese Dioxide / Copper Oxide (MnO2/CuO Carulite 200) Heated Catalytic Bed
pawReactorSystems.description: High-throughput continuous in-line plasma-liquid reactor for food processing facilities. Utilizes an engineered sanitary venturi throat to induce hydrodynamic cavitation, shearing injected cold plasma gas into 20–80 micron micro-bubbles to achieve >92% Henry's law mass transfer of reactive oxygen and nitrogen species (RONS) directly into flowing wash water.

pawReactorSystems.name: High-Throughput Clean-Label Nitrite-Free Meat Curing PAW Skid (High-Nitrite Generation)
pawReactorSystems.classification: Continuous Food Ingredient Synthesis Reactor (USDA FSIS Directive 7120.1 Approved Physical Process)
pawReactorSystems.gasInjectionType: Compressed Atmospheric Air with Tuned N2/O2 Ratio (4:1 Nitrogen Optimization)
pawReactorSystems.reactorCoreMaterial: Multichannel Gliding Arc Discharge Plasmadynamic Reactor with Hastelloy C-276 Electrodes
pawReactorSystems.venturiNozzleGeometry: Vortex Swirl Cavitation Injector with In-Line Static Mixer
pawReactorSystems.catalyticOzoneDestructor: Multi-Stage UV-C Photolytic + Carulite Catalytic Ozone Scavenger
pawReactorSystems.description: Specialized plasma-activated water synthesizer engineered specifically to maximize long-lived aqueous nitrite (NO2⁻, 120–250 mg/L) and peroxynitrite precursors. Formulated to replace synthetic sodium nitrite (E250) and cultured celery powder in organic and clean-label frankfurters, bacon, and emulsified charcuterie without carcinogenic nitrosamine formation.

pawReactorSystems.name: Sanitary Continuous Leafy Green & Berry Flume Wash PAW System (Zero-Residue Organic Sanitizer)
pawReactorSystems.classification: Produce Flume Sanitation & Hydro-Cooling Recirculation Skid (FDA Food Safety Modernization Act Compliant)
pawReactorSystems.gasInjectionType: Ambient Filtered Air with In-Line Micro-Desiccant Air Dryer
pawReactorSystems.reactorCoreMaterial: Surface Dielectric Barrier Discharge (SDBD) Ceramic Tubular Module
pawReactorSystems.venturiNozzleGeometry: Multi-Jet Venturi Manifold with Fine Bubble Diffusers
pawReactorSystems.catalyticOzoneDestructor: Regenerative Thermal Catalytic Off-Gas Decomposer (< 0.02 ppm Exhaust)
pawReactorSystems.description: High-volume produce flume washer delivering continuous PAW (ORP +650 to +780 mV, pH 3.2–3.8). Achieves rapid >5-log reduction of Salmonella enterica, Escherichia coli O157:H7, and Listeria monocytogenes on fragile organic baby spinach, strawberries, and cut melons without chemical chlorine byproducts or tissue wilting.

pawReactorSystems.name: Pilot Research Cold Atmospheric Plasma Jet Diagnostics Unit with Optical Emission Spectroscopy (OES)
pawReactorSystems.classification: Food Engineering Laboratory Research Platform (IEC 61010-1 Electrical Safety Certified)
pawReactorSystems.gasInjectionType: Multi-Gas Mass Flow Controller (Ar, He, Air, O2, N2, CO2)
pawReactorSystems.reactorCoreMaterial: Optical Fused Silica Reactor with In-Situ Fiber-Optic Spectrometer Ports
pawReactorSystems.venturiNozzleGeometry: Precision Microfluidic Venturi Channel (0.8 mm Throat)
pawReactorSystems.catalyticOzoneDestructor: Compact Activated Carbon + Heated Metal Oxide Scrubber
pawReactorSystems.description: Precision diagnostic platform equipped with optical emission spectroscopy (OES) to track excited nitrogen (N2 2nd positive system, 337.1 nm), hydroxyl radicals (•OH, 309 nm), and atomic oxygen (O I, 777.4 nm) in real time across the gas-liquid boundary layer.

processingSubstrates.name: Organic Baby Spinach Leaves (Spinacia oleracea)
processingSubstrates.description: Fragile organic leafy greens washed in continuous PAW. Achieves 5.3-log microbial kill while preserving cuticular wax, green chlorophyll pigmentation, and crisp turgor pressure without chlorine or chlorate residues.

processingSubstrates.name: Finely Emulsified Pork & Beef Frankfurter Meat Batter
processingSubstrates.description: Ground meat emulsion mixed with high-nitrite PAW (160 ppm NO2⁻). Acid-promoted nitric oxide binding to myoglobin forms stable nitrosylmyoglobin (MbFe²⁺-NO), yielding classic cured pink color and antioxidant stability without synthetic curing salts.

processingSubstrates.name: Commercial Grade A Whole Table Shell Eggs
processingSubstrates.description: Continuous high-speed spray sanitization of eggshells. Cold PAW penetrates microscopic pore fissures, neutralizing Salmonella biofilm within 30 seconds without thermal albumen denaturation or membrane damage.

processingSubstrates.name: Fresh Harvested Strawberries (Fragaria × ananassa)
processingSubstrates.description: Gentle immersion or misting of soft berries. PAW hydroxyl radicals and aqueous ozone destroy fungal conidia spores, doubling ambient post-harvest retail shelf life without fruit softening or calyx discoloration.

processingSubstrates.name: Eviscerated Broiler Chicken Carcass / Skin Surface
processingSubstrates.description: Continuous pre-chill or post-chill immersion flume. High ORP PAW eradicates foodborne pathogens lodged in feather follicles and skin folds without chlorine bleaching or noxious organic acid off-odors.

processingSubstrates.name: AISI 316L Stainless Steel Dairy Transfer Pipework
processingSubstrates.description: Clean-In-Place (CIP) recirculation through food processing equipment. PAW peroxynitrite and reactive radicals digest extracellular polymeric substances (EPS), destroying mature biofilms without chemical neutralization rinse cycles.
